## Technical analysis (Wednesday July 1, 2026 — Q3 Day 1)

**Pre-market/early session:** Open $195.11 area, Range $195.11–$200.63, volume ~166M (below 200M threshold). NVDA touches $200.63 intraday — the first print above the re-entry gate since the mandatory exit.

**Trend: Recovery channel intact.** NVDA is trading in a $192–$201 range since the June 26 correction low ($192.53). The pre-market $200.63 high is the highest print since June 30's $200.01. The base is building.

**Momentum: Improving but unconfirmed.** RSI estimated ~54 (neutral-positive). The simultaneous intraday gate tests on Q3 Day 1 are the most constructive technical configuration since May 14 ATH. But momentum confirmation requires a close above $200 with volume, not an intraday print.

**Volume: The bottleneck.** ~166M shares at the current rate is below the 200M threshold. Until NVDA closes above $200 on above-average volume (>200M), gate 3 of the re-entry framework remains uncleared. A close above $200 on 166M volume is a false gate clearance — the framework is explicit.

**★ Strongest resistance: $200.** Has capped every meaningful rally since the mandatory exit. The $200.63 intraday print is encouraging but the market's history (three consecutive sessions where $200 has been approached and rejected on a CLOSING basis) makes a confirmed $200+ close the highest-conviction signal available.

**★ Strongest support: $192.53** (June 26 correction low). Six sessions have held above this level — it is the bottom of the post-exit consolidation range.

**Protocol status:** STEP ASIDE. Exit executed June 30 open. Three re-entry gates: (1) SPX >7,460 close ✓ intraday 7,494 — PENDING CLOSE; (2) VIX <17 close ✓ intraday 16.27 — PENDING CLOSE; (3) NVDA >$200 on >200M shares ✓ price intraday $200.63, ✗ volume ~166M — GATE 3 UNCLEARED. Do NOT re-enter before: (a) July 1 closes confirm all three simultaneously, AND (b) NFP July 2 resolves the macro binary.
